description: Presented views (plan schema-language/002 milestone 3): a collection's rows as one of its views presents them, and what a person does to that view as row operations (spec 10 section 4.1). `fixtures` hold a schema.usl, data-file rows by table and people (profile ids and display names, in order). A person may be a placeholder, `contact:<key>`, naming a row of the viewer’s directory (People 001): its chip and group carry `placeholder: true` and show the directory’s name for it when `people` lists it, else the key. A view may be of Person (`re Person { ~views }`, a line per person the rows name), take paths through connections (`ties.group`), sum up a line with `rows: field` and `~latest`/`~earliest`/`~count`, and mark a date `~ago`. A presentation case may name the model (by default the one with ~views, else the first with rows), and names a view by index into the model's views (its ~views, or the default arrangement) and an optional search query. An intent case gives the row operations, without `key` and `collection`, and the rows after applying them; `error: true` means the intent is refused. Row and group ids are as the presentation gives them.
